game.title: Which station is today's mystery?
game.intro: Guess any station. We draw the fastest train trip from there to the mystery station. The shorter the line, the closer you are.
game.guessFailed: That guess didn't go through. Try again.

gameOver.lost: No guesses left. The mystery station was

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.rule1: Guess any station in the Netherlands.
howToPlay.rule2: We draw the fastest train trip from your guess to the mystery station.
howToPlay.rule3: Shorter lines are closer. Find it in six guesses.
howToPlay.exampleCaption: You change trains once, 17 minutes before the mystery station. Guess the station where you change and its name appears.

archive.title: Archive
archive.lead: Every puzzle so far, newest first. Catch up on the ones you missed. Archive puzzles don't count for your streak.
archive.label: Puzzles

networkPicker.title: Networks
networkPicker.lead: Each network has its own daily station.

consent.title: Cookies, only if you're OK with it
consent.copy: Trackdown is a hobby project without ads. Visits are counted anonymously, without cookies. With your OK, PostHog also sets a cookie so I can see how returning players do and make the game better. Nothing is sold. Decline and the game works exactly the same.
consent.accepted: Analytics cookie on. Thanks for helping improve Trackdown.
consent.declined: No analytics cookie. Visits are only counted anonymously.

footer.tagline: Trackdown, a hobby project by Bram Gussekloo
